activity_summary: You read the Rose's afternoon, Harry the Fifth at two, and you did not go. Your own house had an afternoon of its own.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the bill and stayed in his own yard.

entities.name: Philip Henslowe
entities.context: Not in the yard. His afternoon was on the board, and that was all.

entities.name: Harry the Fifth
entities.context: Mentioned in Harry the Fifth, not this yard
